BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD THE REGENT OF CENTRAL LOMBOK,

Considering Recalling that women and children are God's creatures and assets of the nation who must be protected, respected, and have their human rights fulfilled by the State, law and government to obtain true welfare as stated in Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia: that women and children need protection from various forms of violence, exploitation, child marriage, and neglect, there is a need for strategic efforts from the Regional Government and other parties who are obliged to provide protection for women and children, that Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency Number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence is no longer in accordance with the development of laws and policies on the protection of women and children established by the government and provincial government so it needs to be replaced, that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Article 33

(1) The regional government establishes UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victim Families, and/or Witnesses.

(2) UPTD PPA is positioned in the work unit that carries out governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

(3) The establishment of UPTD PPA is stipulated by Regent Regulation after meeting the requirements in accordance with statutory provisions.

(4) UPTD PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) has the duty of: receiving reports or outreach to Victims, a.

b. providing information about Victims' rights, facilitating the provision of health services, &.

. facilitating the provision of psychological strengthening services, d facilitating the provision of psychosocial services, social rehabilitation, social empowerment, and social reintegration, providing legal services, identifying economic empowerment needs: identifying temporary shelter needs for Victims and Victim Families that need to be fulfilled immediately, facilitating the needs of Victims with Disabilities, coordinating and working together on the fulfillment of Victims' rights with other institutions, and monitoring the fulfillment of Victims' rights by law enforcement apparatus during the judicial process.

Article 41

UPTD PPA that has been established before this regional regulation is promulgated shall continue to carry out its duties and functions related to the Protection of women and children and must adapt to this regional regulation no later than 1 (one) year from the promulgation of this Regional regulation.

(2) In the event that UPTD PPA has not been established, the establishment of UPTD PPA shall be carried out no later than 2 (years) years from the promulgation of this regional regulation.

(3) In the event that UPTD PPA has not been established as referred to in paragraph (2), the implementation of Integrated Services in the region shall be conducted by the regional work unit that administers government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Considering Recalling that women and children are God's creatures and assets of the nation who must be protected, respected, and have their human rights fulfilled by the State, law and government to obtain true welfare as stated in Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia: that women and children need protection from various forms of violence, exploitation, child marriage, and neglect, there is a need for strategic efforts from the Regional Government and other parties who are obliged to provide protection for women and children, that Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency Number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence is no longer in accordance with the development of laws and policies on the protection of women and children established by the government and provincial government so it needs to be replaced, that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Considering Recalling that women and children are God's creatures and assets of the nation who must be protected, respected, and have their human rights fulfilled by the State, law and government to obtain true welfare as stated in Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia: that women and children need protection from various forms of violence, exploitation, child marriage, and neglect, there is a need for strategic efforts from the Regional Government and other parties who are obliged to provide protection for women and children, that Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency Number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence is no longer in accordance with the development of laws and policies on the protection of women and children established by the government and provincial government so it needs to be replaced, that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Considering Recalling that women and children are God's creatures and assets of the nation who must be protected, respected, and have their human rights fulfilled by the State, law and government to obtain true welfare as stated in Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia: that women and children need protection from various forms of violence, exploitation, child marriage, and neglect, there is a need for strategic efforts from the Regional Government and other parties who are obliged to provide protection for women and children, that Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency Number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence is no longer in accordance with the development of laws and policies on the protection of women and children established by the government and provincial government so it needs to be replaced, that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 year 2009 concerning Protection of child and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women whether taken by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore at the regency regional regulation level adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis in implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional governance has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 Year 2004 concerning Regional Governance by Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Governance. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance that the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 year 2014 concerning Regional Governance is regulated in more detail the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection. The field of women includes authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at regency/city Region level. Field. Women's Quality of Life includes, Institutionalization of PUG at government institutions at regency/city Region level. b. Women's empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields at community organizations at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA at government, non-government institutions, and business world at regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of institutions providing services for improving children's quality of life at regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children requiring special protection includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection requiring coordination at regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening development of institutions providing services for children requiring special Protection at regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments namely 1). law number 35 year 2014 concerning amendment to law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 Year 2016 Concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Protection of Children Into Law. There are a number of regional government obligations contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulation. Amendments to law number 23 year 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women significant changes occurred when law number 12 year 2022 concerning criminal acts of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to regional government obligations that must be regulated in regional regulation: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA which organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of Central Government and Regional Government are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, integrated, and integrated. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Government is obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).
